answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8059 Country: United Kingdom Title: 1-If I send my Qurbani to be done , in say India and there Eid occurs a day before Eid in UK. What is the Sharee ruling concerning my Qurbani if they slaughter it on their Eid day? Question: 1-If I send my Qurbani to be done , in say India and there Eid occurs a day before Eid in UK. What is the Sharee ruling concerning my Qurbani if they slaughter it on their Eid day? Answer ID: 8059 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1947/1711=B/1429) You should offer Qurbani as per Indian calendar on the second or third day of Eid, then it will be valid; otherwise not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
